_about: Charles Drelincourt (1595-1669), pastor of the Reformed church at Charenton: The Christian's Defence against the Fears of Death, with seasonable directions how to prepare ourselves to die (New York: printed by James Oram, 1808). The English translation is Marius D'Assigny's, which the scan does not name, so no translator is claimed. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.
